The Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival Safety Plan
dialogues.text: "Uh, Shinobu, this really is a lot. Are we ever going to see the end of it? Also, are we really going to need all this to get approval?"

dialogues.speaker: The Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival Safety Plan
dialogues.text: "If I say write, you write! Also, when the Boss and I aren't around, you *will* follow these instructions. Got it? Good. Now keep writing!"
